repaired.script:
t = (#Living_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("The living room is " + t + " degrees")

diagnosis.summary: The candidate script translates the temperature value into Korean ('거실 온도는 ... 도입니다'), whereas the IR specification requires the exact English string ('The living room is $t degrees'). The mismatch is a literal string argument error, not a logic or timing issue.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the Korean string literal with the exact English string literal specified in the IR, preserving the variable substitution syntax ($t).
